reviews.text: She really only thinks about cash, the prices are outrageous, I wouldn't take my little one to a place like that.

My first contact with the clinic was when I took my cat to get tested for FIV/FeLV, and the doctor was very attentive and answered all my questions about the test, advising that it shouldn't be done yet because she wasn't old enough. That day, he didn't even charge for the consultation.
Later I took her back along with my other cat and we did the test on both of them.
They answer our questions on WhatsApp and provide all the necessary guidance.
The reception is good and the veterinarians are very attentive, and you can see the love they have for our pets.

Everyone at the clinic is extremely caring and professional.

You can take your pet there with confidence.
Dr. Robson is top-notch. He takes care of my two kittens. Very humane and an excellent professional.

Dr. Robson and Dr. Fernanda are angels who fell from heaven at the most difficult time I'm going through with my kidney patient, Pingo. The care they received from the moment I arrived at reception was wonderful!

I have no words to describe these two professionals. I recommend them to everyone I can; you will be in excellent hands.

For me, it's the best veterinary clinic in the region, without a doubt.
Dr. Robson is an excellent professional, who even offered to follow up on my pet's treatment and guide me via WhatsApp. The clinic is well-organized and has a great team of doctors.
The only downside is the opening hours, which in my opinion could be longer, and even better if it were 24 hours a day, haha.
Excellent professionals, great service, care and affection for our pets. Very helpful and loving. I highly recommend them.

In December 2025, my cat Cyndi was hit by a car. She was treated at the clinic by Dr. Robson, who provided excellent care. The accident was serious, and she had to go to a specialized veterinary hospital for complex surgery. Dr. Robson was always present and acted impeccably. I leave here my gratitude! Thank you very much, Dr. Robson and team!
The doctors are wonderful, very attentive and helpful, they treat the animal super well, and the service is top-notch from reception to the doctor. They deserve all the praise! ❤️

I met Dr. Robson in 2018 or 2019, I don't remember exactly, but I was delighted with this man's work from the moment I took my kitten to him. I thought she wouldn't survive, and he, with great perseverance, assured me that she would, and she did. Since then, all my pets have been treated by him. I recommend him without hesitation because I know what a great professional he is. Much gratitude to Dr. Robson ❤️
Dr. Robson and his team are wonderful, and yes, they treat my daughter Bibi, who has kidney disease... she receives personalized treatment.
The best in the region, a wonderful team.

My experience was bad from the start, as the hours were listed as closing at 6 PM, but I arrived at 5:30 PM and it was already closed. I returned the next day, and they don't even attend to walk-ins; it was very disorganized. The vet barely …
Excellent service! They are also great at giving instructions on the phone. They accepted the health insurance plan.
Excellent service and welcoming atmosphere. Dr. Robson is very attentive and caring with the animals. It's great to know that we have an excellent veterinary clinic in our region.

Thank you for your feedback.

We are working every day to improve and provide well-being to pet owners and their pets.
